verdict.rationale: CAM's TMT sector page explicitly claims data privacy advisory work, and its Co-Head Digital/TMT partner authored analysis of India's DPDP Rules 2025, which shows the firm counsels on Indian data-protection compliance. However, the privacy work sits inside the TMT practice rather than in a dedicated, documented privacy/cyber practice, and no GDPR, CCPA or cybersecurity work is evidenced. Missing for 10: a dedicated privacy/cybersecurity practice page, evidence of GDPR/CCPA or cross-border privacy counsel, cyber incident-response capability, and independent corroboration such as rankings or client matters.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: We pride ourselves on our advice in the data privacy space, which has always been ahead of the curve
India's digital privacy regime entered a new phase with the notification of the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Rules, 2025.
